Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, a functional derivative __as defined by the specification__ or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor; and (B) an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII __(Angiotensin II)__, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative __as defined by the specification__ or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor, an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII __(Angiotensin II)__, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative __as defined by the specification__ or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII __(Angiotensin II)__, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 3, wherein components (I) and (II) are suitable for sequential, separate and/or simultaneous use in the treatment of hypertension and/or conditions characterised by microvascular dysfunction and/or lesions. 

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 4, wherein the condition is hypertension, diabetic retinopathy, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis and/or glomerulosclerosis.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the component that is BH4 or a functional derivative __as defined by the specification__ or biosynthetic precursor thereof is a compound of formula I, O R HN R2 N R3 R -N N N R4 H R5 R wherein R1 and R2 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; R3 represents aryl or C1-4 alkyl, which alkyl group is optionally substituted by one or more substituents selected from aryl, OR7 and oxo; R7 represents, independently at each occurrence, H or C(O)R8; R8 represents C1-4 alkyl, aryl, C1-4 alkoxy and C1-4 alkylamino; R4 and R5 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; and R6 represents H or C(O)-C1-3 alkyl.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 6, wherein R1 and R2 either both represent H or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 6 or Claim 7, wherein R3 represents phenyl (optionally substituted by one to three substituents selected from halo, C1-3 alkyl and C1-3 alkoxy) or C1-4 alkyl, which alkyl group is optionally substituted by one or two substituents selected from OR7 and oxo; 

Claim 9 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 6 to 8, wherein R7 represents, independently at each occurrence, H or C(O)-C1-3 alkyl.

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 6 to 9, wherein R4 and R5 both represent H.

Claim 11 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 6 to 10, wherein R6 represents H.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of Claims 6 to 11, wherein R3 represents -CH3, -CH2OH, -C(O)C(O)CH3, -C(O)CH(OH)CH3, -CH(OH)CH(OH)CH3, -CH(OC(O)CH3)CH(OC(O)CH3)CH3 or unsubstituted phenyl.

Claim 13 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII __(Angiotensin II)__ is a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor or an AT1 receptor antagonist.

Claim 14 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 13, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII __(Angiotensin II)__ is a compound selected from the group consisting of aliskiren, ditekiren, enalkiren, remikiren, terlakiren, zankiren, benazepril, captopril, cilazapril, enalapril, fosinopril, lisinopril, moexepril, perindopril, quinapril, ramipril, trandolapril, candesartan, eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan, ciclosidomine, furosemide and saralasin.

Claim 15 (Currently Amended): A combination product as claimed in Claim 14, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII __(Angiotensin II)__ is a compound selected from the group consisting of eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan or, particularly, candesartan (optionally in prodrug form, such as __candesartan cilexetil__).

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): A method of making a kit of parts as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, which method comprises bringing a component (I), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, into association with a component (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15, thus rendering the two components suitable for administration in conjunction with each other.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended): A kit of parts comprising: (1) one of components (I) and (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15; together with (2) instructions to use that component in conjunction with the other of the two components.
